Thanks Marissa — answering at a high level here and attaching where possible. Notes below are intended for the customer response; we should be conservative on timelines.

SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security and Availability in June 2024. We can share a redacted executive summary now (see attached). Full SOC report can be shared under standard NDA — Mina will own that exchange.

SIG / CAIQ: We maintain a CAIQ export and a partially completed SIG; CAIQ is the quickest item to provide (controls mapping + evidence references). SIG has a few open evidence fields tied to recent infra changes (KV cache and quantization infra), which we can close in the next 2 weeks.

ISO 27001: We do not yet hold ISO 27001 certification. Current plan: formal ISMS implementation underway; target certification window is Q2 2026. Initial scope proposal (attached ISO-Scope-Draft) covers Redwood API (hosted), Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity), and control plane services. On-prem/private bundles (customer-managed infra) will be out of scope for the first cert — we can provide policy coverage but not certification.

FedRAMP: We are evaluating options. Two paths being considered: (1) operate in a FedRAMP-authorized cloud partner (preferred short-term) or (2) pursue sponsor ATO in the medium term. We do not currently hold a FedRAMP authorization. We plan a readiness assessment with a 3rd party consultant in Q1 2026 and a formal scoping memo to customers in parallel. For procurement timelines this year, we can provide a FedRAMP scoping memo and our CAIQ + SIG status to help customers understand gaps.

Evidence we can provide quickly (within 3 business days):
- SOC2 executive summary (attached stub)
- CAIQ export (redacted)
- Network architecture diagram and VPC boundaries (redacted)
- KMS usage summary and key rotation policy excerpt
- Penetration test executive summary (redacted)
- PPT: Logging, retention, and incident response highlights

Evidence requiring an NDA or longer lead time:
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (NDA)
- Detailed vulnerability scan artifacts (scheduled staging scan windows)
- Full ISMS documents (policy set will be available during ISO implementation)

Suggested next steps for customer-ready response:
1) Offer a short discovery call (30–45m) with Karthik (security) + Marissa (sales) to cover scope and any non-negotiable requirements — propose Aug 21–22 windows.
2) Provide SOC2 summary + CAIQ + ISO scope draft + FedRAMP planning checklist as attachments.
3) Offer to start an NDA exchange if Acme needs the full SOC report.

I'll upload the CAIQ export and network diagram to the shared Drive folder and link from the reply.
